column_values.long_text_mm7fv3sg: Owner-mandated step 1: independent Page, Focus, Flow and Narrate state, lifecycle, timers, callbacks, DOM/rendering and styles. Execution requires a clean isolated checkout and fresh baseline tests/build; no code, tests or live QA have run in this review. Existing ISO-1 adapters remain completed historical groundwork. No TTS tuning, feature additions or deduplication. Four downstream items remain Blocked/Stub until separation closes and their edit sites are re-specified.
